title: Salesforce Director
description:
Pessoa Diretora de Salesforce

Objetivo da Posição

Como uma empresa global de serviços profissionais em tecnologia e transformação digital, buscamos Diretor(a) de Salesforce que terá como missão liderar a evolução e o fortalecimento a divisão de Salesforce, estruturando a operação no Brasil, garantindo a entrega de projetos complexos com excelência e construindo relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros. Trata-se de uma posição que exige visão integrada de negócios, capacidade de gerar novos contratos de forma autônoma e habilidade para estruturar equipes de alta performance em um ambiente de crescimento acelerado.

Principais Desafios e Atribuições

  • Escalar a operação de Salesforce, estruturando processos, equipes e padrões de qualidade, alinhados às demandas de múltiplos setores e soluções da plataforma.
  • Atuar de forma independente na geração de negócios, incluindo prospecção, desenvolvimento de propostas e fechamento de contratos.
  • Equilibrar as frentes de vendas, entrega e gestão de pessoas, assegurando eficiência operacional, margens saudáveis e satisfação do cliente.
  • Ser o ponto focal no relacionamento com a Salesforce, ampliando sinergias locais, iniciativas conjuntas e participação em fóruns estratégicos.
  • Representar a prática com postura executiva, influenciando stakeholders internos e externos, e garantindo a evolução sustentável do negócio.
  • Desenvolver talentos e formar lideranças alinhadas à cultura de alta performance e ao crescimento de longo prazo.

Experiência e Qualificações Profissionais

  • Experiência sólida e anos de experiência, em consultoria de tecnologia, com histórico consistente em projetos e práticas baseadas em Salesforce.
  • Vivência prévia em funções de liderança, seja em unidades de negócio, consultorias, empresas de software ou como cliente corporativo da plataforma.
  • Histórico comprovado em vendas consultivas: prospecção, negociação e fechamento de contratos estratégicos.
  • Experiência robusta na gestão de projetos complexos de transformação digital com Salesforce (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, MuleSoft, entre outros).
  • Relacionamento prévio com a Salesforce ou atuação em empresas parceiras será considerado diferencial.
  • Formação superior em áreas relevantes (ex.: Engenharia, Computação, Tecnologia).
  • Certificações Salesforce desejáveis (ex.: Technical Architect, Application Architect), mas não eliminatórias.

Habilidades Comportamentais

  • Energia e ambição estratégica: motivação genuína para crescer, liderar e construir legado.
  • Visão integrada de negócios: capacidade de navegar entre vendas, entrega e gestão de pessoas.
  • Liderança com postura executiva: maturidade, clareza e influência em ambientes de alta exigência.
  • Relacionamento e influência: habilidade para construir e sustentar conexões sólidas com clientes e parceiros estratégicos.
  • Resiliência e adaptabilidade: atuação consistente em ambientes complexos, sob pressão e com grandes contratos em jogo.

title: Analista Júnior de Dados - Pessoa com Deficiência
description:
Descrição da vaga

Apoiar todo o ciclo de Business Intelligence, desde a extração e transformação dos dados (ETL) até a modelagem e a construção de dashboards que orientam a tomada de decisão dos nossos clientes.

Esse profissional atuará de forma colaborativa na expansão e melhoria do uso das soluções de BI, contribuindo para que os clientes explorem ao máximo os indicadores e análises disponíveis. Atuará em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, com contato direto com clientes e equipes internas, desenvolvendo soluções que agreguem valor e impulsionem resultados.

Além disso, terá a oportunidade de participar da revitalização da nossa área de dados, com projetos estratégicos que envolvem o uso de tecnologias como GoodData, BigQuery e Inteligência Artificial, fortalecendo a jornada de transformação digital e ampliando sua experiência em análise de dados e inteligência de negócios.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Participar da modelagem e desenvolvimento de soluções de Business Intelligence;
  • Desenvolver e manter consultas SQL e processos de ETL;
  • Construir e dar manutenção em dashboards e relatórios;
  • Prestar suporte consultivo aos clientes, auxiliando na criação de métricas, cálculos e indicadores;
  • Fazer a interface entre clientes, equipe de suporte e desenvolvedores;
  • Apoiar a manutenção e evolução do Data Warehouse;
  • Contribuir para o uso estratégico das soluções de BI pelos clientes
  • 1x presencialmente no escritório TOTVS Matriz.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência em atividades relacionadas a dados, BI ou análise de informações;
  • Conhecimento em SQL, incluindo consultas, manipulação e modelagem básica de dados;
  • Experiência em criação de dashboards em alguma ferramenta de Business Intelligence (ex: GoodData, Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, etc.).

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em BigQuery;
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de ETL;
  • Conhecimento em linguagem Python;
  • Noções de modelagem multidimensional e/ou Data Warehouse;
  • Vivência em suporte ou consultoria de dados, atendendo clientes e ajudando na definição de indicadores.

Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;

Responsibilities:

1.Customers' main technical point of contact from pre-sales to post sales, design-in, validation, regression, product launch and post maintenance.

2.Provide on-site and remote support to customers during the entire design/launch process: integration, validation, pilot, mass production and maintenance.

3.Collaborate with R&D to transfer debug and design knowledge of our products to our customers.

4.Hands-on activities involving proof of concept demos, use case implementations and systems validations of our evaluation kits or other IoT systems.

5.Organize technical training, presentation or workshop to customers, partners or internal stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • 1.5+ years of software engineering and/or FAE experience within the cellular phone or wireless module industry.
  • 2.Hands-on cellular experience with relevant industry technology including 5G, LTE, and/or CatM.
  • 3.Hands-on experience in Android or Linux development or integration environment.
  • 4.Strong technical, analytical and presentation skills.
  • 5.Familiarity with hardware design or software architecture a plus.
  • 6.Familiarity with RTOS or other embedded systems development environment a plus.
  • 7.Travel up to 25%, domestic and international.
  • 8.Fluent in Mandarin Chinese preferred.

About Fibocom:

Fibocom Wireless INC. (SHE: ) is a leading global provider of wireless modules for the Internet of Things (IoT). The company provides cellular communications modules of all technologies and LBS solutions that enable secure IoT applications globally across many verticals.

Fibocom's global sales channel, logistics, manufacturing and support allow enterprises to simplify operations, increase efficiency and create new business models. Since 1999, Fibocom has been delivering a trusted and secure environment in Telematics, wireless retail systems, metering and smart grids, security systems, routers and gateways, digital signage and mobile internet.

Fibocom is based in Shenzhen, China with global footprint in the United States, Taiwan,;Germany and India.

title: Data Integration Specialist
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

The Data Integration Specialist designs and implements the technical infrastructure needed to consolidate the school’s data into a centralized repository. This role develops and maintains automated data pipelines, integrates multiple systems, and ensures data is structured for reporting. The specialist also supports the creation of dashboards and visualizations in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom web applications, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate data from multiple school systems and spreadsheets.Automated data pipelines (APIs, CSV, ETL processes, cloud-based tools) reducing manual work and improving accuracy.
  • Build and manage automated ETL processes (APIs, SQL, Python scripts, CSV workflows).
  • Use Microsoft cloud tools (e.g., Data Factory, Power Automate) to streamline and automate workflows.Dashboards and reports delivered in Looker Studio, Power BI, or custom-built web applications.
  • Maintain and enhance data-oriented web applications based on front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React) and backend development (e.g., Python or .NET).
  • Document data structures, pipelines, and integration standards to ensure long-term sustainability.
  • Collaborate with the Systems & Data Admin to validate that technical outputs meet business needs.
  • Ensure solutions are cost-effective and appropriate for a K12 international school context.

Qualifications

Candidates should bring most or all of the following:

  • Solid experience in a similar role.
  • Experience with relational databases (MSSQL, PostgreSQL, or similar).
  • Ability to design data models and schemas for reporting.Strong technical skills in data integration (APIs, SQL, CSV, ETL).
  • Proficiency with visualization tools (Looker Studio, Power BI).Proficiency with Python for data manipulation and system integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud automation tools (Microsoft Data Factory, Power Automate).
  • Ability to support and maintain custom dashboards and webapps (Azure, Python, Angular, Bootstrap).Use of Git/version control and documentation for maintainability.
  • Apply data quality assurance practices: cleaning, validating, monitoring pipelines.
  • Shows humility and confidence.
  • Tech "positive" - see upsides and opportunities in using tech for learning

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Managing Director
description:
About Us

XCELiS is made up of a team of Supply Chain specialists with over 15 years of experience optimizing and transforming business results in Brazil and abroad.

We operate end-to-end across the supply chain, from design to implementation, delivering performance optimization and results-driven projects in areas such as Logistics Network, Transportation, Warehousing, Planning, E-Commerce/Omnichannel, Procurement, Technology, and Control Tower.

We are certified in Organizational Climate by FEEx 2023 and 2024, recognized as leaders in Supply Chain Advisory and Consulting Services and as Contender in the Supply Chain IT Operation Services quadrant of the ISG Provider LensTM Supply Chain Services Brazil 2023 study. In addition, we were awarded 1st place by INBRASC in 2023 in the categories Logistics Consulting and TMS Provider.

Job descripiton:

The Managing Director in Supply Chain Transformation at XCELiS is a senior, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader responsible for expanding new business and leading end-to-end supply chain transformation projects. This professional will combine deep expertise in logistics, planning (S&OP), procurement, and digital technologies. The goal is to position XCELiS as the leading consulting firm in supply chain solutions, delivering measurable value, pragmatism, resilience, competitive advantage, and results for our clients.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Market Strategy

  • Manage the financial performance (P&L) of projects in partnership with the finance team.
  • Lead the prospecting of complex Supply Chain projects, from diagnosis to the implementation of S&OP, logistics, and digitalization solutions.
  • Act as the primary advisor to C-level clients (CSCO, COO, CEO), translating their business challenges into robust supply chain strategies.
  • Develop and price value propositions that clearly demonstrate ROI, focusing on cost optimization, service improvement, and risk mitigation.
  • Represent XCELiS in the Supply Chain ecosystem by speaking at events, publishing articles, and building a strong professional network.

Leadership and Delivery of Supply Chain Projects

  • Oversee the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring the application of best practices in demand planning, inventory management, logistics network optimization, and automation.
  • Provide final review and strategic guidance to project teams, ensuring solutions are not only theoretical but also practical and high-impact.
  • Manage the inherent challenges of transformation projects, such as change management, system integration (ERP, WMS, TMS), and stakeholder alignment.
  • Lead and mentor a team of specialized Supply Chain consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
  • Identify emerging trends (AI in logistics, blockchain, sustainability in supply chains) and develop new service offerings for XCELiS.

Qualifications and Competencies

Academic Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, etc.), Business Administration, or Economics.
  • Postgraduate degree, MBA, Master’s, or PhD with a focus on Supply Chain or Logistics is highly desirable.

Technical Skills (Supply Chain)

  • End-to-end supply chain expertise: Planning (S&OP/IBP), Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics (Transportation and Warehousing), and Customer Service.
  • Proven experience leading logistics network optimization projects, distribution center design, TMS/WMS implementation, and inventory management strategies.

  • Partnerships with universities and language schools (discounts available)

title: Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: On-Site IT Support Engineer

Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.

Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.

Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.

Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.

Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.

Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.

Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Senior Sales Development Representative
description:

As a Senior SDR, you’ll be responsible for creating high-quality opportunities for our Managing Director through proactive outbound outreach across multiple channels. Your mission: generate meaningful conversations with hiring leaders at mid-market companies (100–5,000 employees) across the U.S.

This role is high-volume, phone-led, and metrics-driven—best suited for someone who thrives in a high-energy environment and knows how to position consulting services in a competitive market.

  • Own the top of the funnel for all outbound activity across phone, email, and LinkedIn

  • Track activity and pipeline through SourceWhale and internal CRM systems
  • Partner closely with the Managing Director to ensure meeting quality and ICP alignment
  • Iterate and improve outreach campaigns based on performance metrics and conversion data

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5+ years of SDR experience in a B2B consulting or staffing/recruiting environment
  • Proven success generating meetings with mid-market U.S. clients
  • Mastery of cold calling and sales engagement tools (SourceWhale, ZoomInfo, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of professional services, especially in technology, product, or executive search
  • Confident, curious, and motivated by the challenge of breaking into new accounts
  • Comfortable with high daily activity targets and KPI-driven accountability
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

What You’ll Get

  • Base salary + bonuses with uncapped earning potential

  • Flexible, remote-first work culture with outcome-driven autonomy
  • Access to best-in-class tools to power your outreach and workflow
  • Opportunity to grow into a full-cycle sales or account management role

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose

The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.

⸻

Core Responsibilities

• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts.

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations, manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.

• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules.

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.

• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders, with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.

⸻

Key Qualifications

• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.

• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Commercial Account Executive

title: Analista de Planejamento Comercial e CRM pleno
description:
Sobre a Bip

Nascida em Milão no ano de 2003, temos uma história de crescimento exponencial. De 44 pessoas, hoje somos mais de 4500 em todo o mundo, presentes em 4 continentes e em mais de 14 países. Ao longo de todos esses anos crescemos significativamente e transformamos milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho!

Somos guiados por três grandes sonhos...

I. Ser a empresa que sempre sonhamos e que sonhamos para sempre

Espelha o desejo de evolução constante e perenizarão da empresa através de uma cultura forte centrada em pessoas e que essas pessoas pratiquem constantemente a ownership. Que para nós significa liberdade com autonomia de dono e responsabilidade pelo futuro da organização.

II. Presente em ecossistema inovador

Significa ter e desenvolver constantemente, internamente ou através de parceiros, soluções inovadoras que promovam impactos em nossos clientes e que sejam o pilar de nossa perenidade. Pois só um repensar constante nos manterá atuantes no mercado.

III. Socialmente Engajada

Conscientes dos aspectos sociais do nosso país, transformamos o nosso conhecimento, a nossa capacidade de execução e networking em impactos positivos e constantes.

Para realizar nossos sonhos, alcançar nossa visão e honrar o porquê existimos, precisamos fortalecer muito bem quem nós somos. Nunca esquecendo da nossa autenticidade e da nossa singularidade.

Nossos benefícios são flexíveis e você poderá distribuí-los de acordo com suas necessidades e interesses:

  • All Points (Programa de pontos para passagens áreas e hospedagens)

Sobre a vaga:

Principais Atividades:

  • Suporte à área comercial referente a processos de encarteiramento de clientes no CRM.
  • Monitoramento dos indicadores de processamento do CRM e elaboração de relatórios desses indicadores.
  • Análise e estudo dos modelos de alocação comercial para otimização de recursos.
  • Contribuição para a melhoria contínua dos processos de suporte, elaboração de relatórios.
  • Garantir reports diários e semanais de acompanhamento do volume de vendas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração de Empresas / Engenharia / Economia e áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em área de planejamento comercial.
  • Desejável experiencia com o uso do Salesforce.
  • Competência na análise e interpretação de dados financeiros e comerciais.
  • Conhecimento de SQL, Power BI e ou Python (pandas).
  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento, negociação e análise.
  • Boa capacidade de organização, gestão de tempo e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Excel, PBI, SQL e/ou Knime e o Phyton será um diferencial.

Vaga também para PcD

SOMOS DIFERENTES DE TUDO O QUE VOCÊ JÁ VIU!

Faça parte da BIP: Um ecossistema inovador, humano, ousado e revolucionário.

Somos uma consultoria internacional de transformação de negócios, fundada na Itália em 2003, há 20 anos impactando milhares de pessoas através do nosso trabalho.

Com nosso espírito jovem, vivemos em um ecossistema em evolução que entrega transformação significativa por meio de uma abordagem personalizada.

Por aqui, não falta oportunidade para você crescer.

ESTAMOS PRESENTE EM DIVERSOS LOCAIS DO MUNDO!

+40 países de atuação + 5000 Bipers pelo mundo +700 projetos no mercado

Tudo o que temos e construímos para um futuro que se aproxima, é guiado pelo nosso

PROPÓSITO:

Pursuing Changes, Nurturing Progress

A mudança é a base de nossa mentalidade, aprendemos e reaprendemos constantemente. Somos desafiadores, assumimos o risco de explorar novas formas de tornar as coisas melhores, inovadoras e sustentáveis para nós, para os nossos clientes e para a sociedade a qual pertencemos. Esforçamo-nos para criar o que ainda não existe, bem como para cuidar e fazer crescer o que existe. Não deixamos pedra sobre pedra – isso é o quão longe ousamos ir.

title: Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística
description:
A inovação e o pioneirismo sempre fizeram parte da nossa história, que começou em 1980. Temos o DNA de varejo, já que nascemos da Pernambucanas – marca centenária que sempre contou com os serviços financeiros para apoiar as famílias brasileiras de maneira fácil e democrática. Ao longo dos anos, as soluções evoluíram e se diversificaram, permitindo à Pefisa se consolidar no mercado financeiro.

Somos responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e gestão de produtos como cartões, empréstimo pessoal, seguros e a conta digital, com diferenciais como simplicidade, praticidade e sem burocracia. Prezamos por bons relacionamentos, pelo atendimento próximo e por jogar junto.

Com mais de 5 milhões de clientes ativos e grande relevância na área do varejo, disponibilizamos um amplo portfólio de serviços para pessoas físicas e jurídicas, além de um Banking as a Service (BaaS) para marcas de diversos segmentos. Com isso, adotamos iniciativas inovadoras para clientes e parceiros.

Na Pefisa tudo é simples. Tudo é rápido. Te ajudamos com o que você precisa para realizar seus sonhos ou alavancar seu negócio. E você escolhe como quer conversar, pois nós somos Fígital. Atuamos com a melhor experiência entre o físico e o digital, com nossas plataformas digitais ou através de nossas lojas físicas. Somos a fintech pra gente como a gente.

Se você se identifica com nossos valores, essa é a sua chance de brilhar!

Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística

Resumo da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Analista Pleno de Modelagem Estatística para integrar nosso time. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver, validar e implementar modelos estatísticos para apoiar a tomada de decisões estratégicas e operacionais da empresa.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar modelos estatísticos para análise de dados e previsão de tendências.
  • Realizar tratamento, limpeza e análise exploratória de dados.
  • Validar e monitorar a performance dos modelos, garantindo sua aderência e robustez.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções estatísticas.
  • Documentar processos, resultados e apresentar insights.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de programação e softwares estatísticos para análise e modelagem.
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos modelos e metodologias aplicadas.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Economia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada em modelagem estatística e análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em técnicas de regressão, séries temporais, análise multivariada, machine learning.
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como R, Python, SAS ou similares.
  • Habilidade em manipulação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados Conhecimento em visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau, etc.) será um diferencial.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e boa comunicação para apresentação de resultados.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com modelos preditivos aplicados a negócios financeiros, seguros ou varejo.

title: Volunteer Doctor, South Africa
description:
Are you passionate about using your knowledge and skills to help others? Answer your calling, and take your leave of purpose.

The Tshemba Foundation is appealing to international doctors to address a critical health care gap in rural South Africa’s north eastern provinces where doctor shortages are posing substantial challenges to adequate health care.

You will experience and learn from a stimulating and challenging working environment, treat conditions and cases not usually seen in urban areas and help leave a legacy of improved quality of care by sharing knowledge and skills with local staff who are eager for support.

Tshemba offers its volunteers free, safe and secure accommodation at its Volunteer Lodge, situated in Moditlo Private Game Reserve. The Lodge serves as a welcome off-duty refuge where like-minded healthcare providers relax after an intense day of work. Here they exchange ideas, create healthcare solutions for daily challenges faced and connect with peers from all over the world, all the while taking in the magnificent natural surroundings.

In your role as a volunteer doctor you can offer:

  • direct or indirect patient care in various departments of a public hospital and/or surrounding clinics
  • postgraduate support to medical staff in training
  • skills development and/or formal teaching for local staff
  • administrative or management support, including clinical and quality improvement projects
  • develop health interventions and protocols alongside local staff

Our clinical team will work with you to develop a personalized volunteer schedule that combines your skills and experience with the needs of various hospital departments and clinics in the area.

Length of placement:

  • Currently, volunteer placement lengths are flexible based on your area of expertise. We recommend a minimum of 8 weeks for generalist international volunteers and can negotiate shorter stays for specialists. We will work with you to determine where you will be placed and how long your stay will be to have maximum impact.

Requirements:

  • A current license in good standing from your medical regulatory body
  • Registration with ECFMG and the Health Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) which our team will assist you to apply for. Current ECFMG certification will expedite the process.
  • We welcome interest from ALL REGISTERED PHYSICIANS however, the greatest current need are for Radiologists, Family physicians, Geriatricians, Neurologists, Dermatologists, Internists, Psychiatrists, Paediatricians, Gastroenterologists, Ophthalmologists and General Surgeons.

Physicians who have volunteered with Tshemba tell us that they have been re-energized and transformed by the experience, and their passion for medicine reignited.

Please reach out if you have any questions and to discuss volunteering your time.

• Review job failures and take corrective action where possible or escalate to Job owner as necessary.

• Log Service Desk ticket (incident) for all JAMS Scheduler Job failures, provide resolution in collaboration with job owner and maintain incident resolution log\ knowledge base.

• Installation of JAMS Client tools, JAMS software updates and\or reporting tools.

• Liaise with JAMS account representative and Sompo procurement in relation to JAMS Scheduler annual support License renewals.

• Build, administer, monitor and maintain JAMS Enterprise Scheduler and System Center Orchestrator environments.

• Work with Application team members to evaluate automation workflow needs and requirements.

• Develop integrations between infrastructure systems for data analysis and reporting through REST API calls.

• Maintain JAMS platform, standard operating procedures, perform changes, apply patches, and updates as required.

• Prevent, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve automation runbook errors.

• Maintain strict change control of the automation infrastructure.

• Continuously identify and report areas of improvement in the automation arena and implement improvements when approved.

• Contribute to on-going research and evaluation of new technologies.

• Responsible for completing other work requirements or tasks that are requested by IT management when necessary to meet the goals and objectives of the department or company.

• Working continuously on a task until completion to ensure business automation workflows remain available 24/7.

• The ability to multitask while ensuring the highest quality of work is maintained.

• Establishing a good working relationship with customers and other IT groups.

• Be able to work independently within established policies and procedures.

• Perform routine tasks unsupervised.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Excellent technical skills including however not limited to Microsoft Operating systems server including PowerShell scripting, Microsoft SQL Server , Microsoft Azure including Logic Apps, JSON Scripting, REST API.

• Azure or AWS Certification is desirable.

• Experience with System Center Orchestrator 2012 or later preferred.

• Experience with JAMS Enterprise Manager is highly desirable and preferred.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

• Strong background in an Infrastructure environment with a minimum of 5 years’ experience.

• Team orientated with the ability to multitask and prioritize workloads.

• Very strong problem solving and analytical skills and is a systemic thinker with an attention to detail.

• Seeks to expand knowledge and experience and is committed to continuous learning.

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

title: Principal Architect
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A "Whatever it takes" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Additional Information

Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Department: Finance LATAM

Reports to: Senior Tax Manager LATAM

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, collaborative environment where your expertise will shape tax operations and support business growth.

What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.
  • Preparing tax calculations for review by external advisors (EY, Deloitte).
  • Managing deferred tax accounting (IFRS and BRGAAP), including annual and half-year calculations.
  • Overseeing reconciliations for tax GL accounts using SAP and Blackline.
  • Coordinating SPED, municipal obligations (withholding tax), IBGE, and BACEN reporting.
  • Supporting Transfer Pricing processes with external specialists.
  • Advising internal teams on tax treatment for various operations.
  • Staying ahead of regulatory changes, including Brazil’s ongoing Tax Reform.
  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.
  • Leading a team of 3 direct reports and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.

title: Formação em Corretor de Seguros
description:
Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros!

Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;

Você se diferenciará, se possuir:

  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.

PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO:

  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

title: Estagiário Atuarial
description:
Conheça a Austral Seguradora:

Somos uma companhia brasileira especializada em soluções ágeis e customizadas para Riscos Corporativos.

Entendemos que desempenhamos um papel crucial no mundo dos negócios, pois ajudamos empresas a gerenciar e mitigar riscos que possam afetar suas operações, finanças e reputação, além de proteger seus ativos.

Através da nossa atuação e das soluções que oferecemos, permitimos que as empresas se concentrem em seus objetivos comerciais, sabendo que estão preparadas para enfrentar desafios inesperados.

Nosso jeito Austral de ser envolve dinamismo, experiência com flexibilidade e um time de especialistas com longa experiência no mercado ressegurador e segurador e sólida reputação na geração de resultados, prontos para lidar com o mercado brasileiro e compreender as necessidades específicas de cada negócio.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco, movidos pelo propósito de ampliar a sensação de segurança das pessoas com quem nos relacionamos, simplificando interações e criando, lado a lado, as melhores soluções.

Superior Cursando Ciências Atuariais

- Calcular e controlar as Provisões Técnicas

- Desenvolver as Notas Técnicas Atuariais

- Prestar informações atuariais à Auditoria Atuarial Independente

- Garantir o cumprimento de normas e processos, mantendo-os atualizados e em conformidade com a legislação em vigor e diretrizes da Companhia.

title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
What is the scope of this role?

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. Responsibilities include preparing and analyzing financial reports, collaborating with Project Managers on resourcing and discrepancies, and supporting project closeouts. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Finance Project Analyst will act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs (LOE – level of effort, T&E, 3rd party Budget consumption, milestones acceptance, invoicing and cash receipts status)
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • As a Project Financial Analyst, you will record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

What skills and experience will you need for this role?

  • 1-3 years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Business Introduction

JD Industrials, a subsidiary of JD Group, focuses on industrial supply chain technologies and services, with a market capitalization of approximately $5 billion.

Our business is to support the development of enterprises from the industrial manufacturing industry through the integrated model of "supply chain + technology + service", and create a B to B procurement platform for industrial products. We provide industrial procurement solutions to more than 7,000 large customers and more than 8 million small and medium-sized business customers. We work with more than 30,000 suppliers of industrial goods, and our platform has more than 40 million SKUs.

Now JD Industrials focuses on developing overseas business, providing one-stop industrial product procurement solutions for enterprises from different countries. Our business has spread to Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East and South America.

Role Overview

We are looking for a key account manager with experience in to B sales.

Location: R. do Paraíso, 595 - 11o Andar - Paraíso, São Paulo - SP,

Job Description

  • Develop and cultivate customer relationships by identifying customer needs and conducting demand exploration.
  • Identify customer requirements and pain points, determine corresponding service strategies, coordinate company resources, and provide solutions to customers.
  • Collaborate closely with business, product, and operations teams to coordinate online purchasing, payment collection, and after-sales services for customers, aiming to enhance customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Fluent in English and Chinese. Proficient in value-based sales.
  • Experience in successful development of new B2B customers and leading major projects.
  • Skilled in expanding business and mobilizing internal and external resources to solve business issues.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and teamwork. Excellent project management and resource integration skills.
  • Identification with JD culture and the online e-commerce industry.

title: Kitchen Sales Designer
description:
About the job

We are looking for a talented Kitchen Sales Designer to join our growing team in Latin America. In this role, you’ll help homeowners create kitchens that are both beautiful and practical. You bring a passion for design, sales, and innovation — always keeping the customer at the center. Together with experienced colleagues, you’ll thrive in a dynamic, creative environment.

What is CORNER Renovation?

CORNER is a kitchen brand dedicated to designing and manufacturing high-quality custom kitchens for homeowners worldwide. As a technology-driven company, we develop our own tools to make renovation seamless. With a distributed team in Ukraine and Argentina, and a growing presence across Latin America, we’re expanding quickly and looking for new talent to join us.

Our mission is simple: to help people create the living spaces they dream of. If that resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team.

Requirements:

  • Strong sense of our style, with the ability to translate it into innovative, next-level designs that combine functionality and aesthetics.
  • Must have fluent/Advanced English
  • Flexibility to work with clients across different time zones
  • Experience with SketchUp and V-ray
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills, able to drive projects forward independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Good understanding of cabinet construction, hardware and assembly, ensuring designs are practical and production-ready.
  • Proven experience in client-facing roles, with the ability to build trust and guide clients through decision-making
  • 5+ years of work experience in the furniture and kitchen design industry
  • Knowledge of 3ds Max/Corona is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Own the entire project cycle, from company presentation to final design.

title: Technical Service Engineer - Building Materials (Mortar Powder & Coatings)
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Service Engineer to provide expert technical support and solutions for our Mortar Powder & building material coatings product lines. This role combines hands-on field troubleshooting, customer training, and collaboration with R&D to optimize product performance and ensure customer satisfaction in construction, industrial, and architectural markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, distributors, and sales teams, resolving issues related to product application, performance, and compatibility (e.g., adhesion failure, curing defects, durability concerns).
  • Conduct on-site visits to diagnose problems and recommend solutions for Mortar Powder (e.g., concrete additives, mortar mixes) and coatings (e.g., epoxy, waterproofing, decorative finishes).
  • Product Training & Documentation
  • Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers, contractors, and internal teams on product usage, safety protocols, and best practices.
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including application guides, safety data sheets (SDS), and troubleshooting manuals.
  • Product Optimization & Testing
  • Collaborate with R&D and QA teams to improve product formulations based on field feedback and performance data.
  • Perform lab and field tests to validate product compatibility with substrates (concrete, wood, metal) and environmental conditions (humidity, temperature).
  • Compliance & Sustainability
  • Ensure products meet industry standards (e.g., ISO, ASTM) and environmental regulations (e.g., low VOC, REACH compliance).
  • Advocate for sustainable solutions, such as eco-friendly coatings or recycled sand powder applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support sales teams by participating in client meetings, demonstrating product value, and addressing technical inquiries during pre- and post-sales phases.
  • Work with supply chain to address logistics or raw material challenges impacting product performance.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.g., NACE, SSPC) are a plus. 3+ years of experience in technical service, R&D, or application engineering within the building materials, coatings, or construction chemicals industry. Sherwin williams,Sika,etc are preferred.

Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Mortar Powder applications (e.g., cementitious systems) and coating technologies (e.g., epoxy, polyurethane, acrylic).
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methods, data analysis, and root-cause analysis for product failures.
  • Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, or digital tools for technical documentation is advantageous.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with green building certifications (e.g., LEED, BREEAM).
  • Multilingual skills for roles supporting global markets (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer site visits and industry events.

title: Technical Support Engineer (Java Stack)
description:
We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused On-Site Technical Support Engineer to provide technical expertise for our financial services products, with a focus on credit industry solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong Java development skills, hands-on experience with MySQL, and a proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in real-time. A background in the credit/banking industry and exceptional client communication skills are essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide on-site and remote technical support for the financial systems, ensuring minimal downtime and rapid resolution of issues.
  • Diagnose and resolve problems related to Java applications, Redis caching, MySQL databases, and associated middleware.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement preventive measures.

System Maintenance & Optimization

  • Monitor system performance, conduct regular health checks, and optimize configurations for Redis, MySQL, and Java applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to deploy patches, updates, and hotfixes in production environments.

Client Communication & Requirements Handling

  • Act as the primary technical liaison between clients and the Chinese teams, transmitting business needs to technical solution arthitect in China.
  • Respond promptly to client operational requests, prioritize tasks, and manage expectations effectively.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

  • Create detailed technical documentation, including incident reports, troubleshooting guides, and best practices.
  • Train clients on system functionalities and operational workflows.

Compliance & Collaboration

  • Ensure solutions adhere to local credit industry regulations (e.g., data security, audit requirements).
  • Work closely with DevOps, QA, and product teams to improve system reliability and user experience.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Java development and debugging (Spring Boot, J2EE, or similar frameworks).
  • Strong experience with MySQL (query optimization, replication, backup/recovery).
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Linux/Unix environments, and scripting (Shell/Python).
  • Knowledge of DevOps tools (Jenkins, Docker) and monitoring systems (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Redis (cluster management, performance tuning) is a plus.

Industry Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in technical support or development roles, preferably within the credit, banking, or fintech sectors.
  • Understanding of credit business processes (e.g., loan management, risk assessment, payment systems).

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel frequently for on-site client support.

Language

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in Java, Redis, MySQL, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
  • Experience with microservices architecture and cloud-native technologies.
  • Knowledge of financial compliance standards (e.g., PCI-DSS, GDPR).
  • Knowledge of credit risk management systems(e.g., FICO, Neurotech).

title: Account Executive (SaaS | Contractor)
description:

title: Lubrificador Industrial
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Lubrificador Industrial para atuar no time de Confiabilidade.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Executar rotinas de lubrificação e coleta de óleo em máquinas e equipamentos conforme plano de manutenção preventiva e corretiva;
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas para identificar falhas, vazamentos ou anomalias relacionadas à lubrificação;
  • Controlar e registrar o consumo de óleos, graxas e outros insumos utilizados;
  • Cumprir normas e procedimentos de segurança do trabalho e uso adequado de EPIs.

Quais os requisitos?

Experiência consolidada na função;

Ensino Médio Completo;

Residir em Barretos, Guaíra ou Morro Agudo.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

  • Ensure high performance and responsiveness of the application.

Skills

  • Proficient in Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
  • Experience with observability technologies (e.g. Datadog).
  • Experience with Git versioning systems.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to manage time effectively.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in backend development.
  • Proven experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC.
  • Familiarity with Git versioning systems.

Languages

Tudo isso graças à nossa cultura de transparência, empatia, colaboração e foco nas pessoas!

Unidade AIR

A Chiesi está totalmente comprometida com o cuidado e a melhoria da qualidade de vida de pessoas que sofrem de doenças respiratórias, incluindo asma e DPOC (Doença Pulmonar Obstrutiva Crônica).

Desenvolver as atividades de promoção médica dos produtos da unidade de negócios Primary Care (Franquia AIR) da empresa, baseando-se nas características e benefícios demonstrados pelos estudos clínicos e conhecimentos médico-científicos, através de visitas e reuniões com médicos, clínicas, hospitais e farmácias; com o objetivo de atingir as metas estabelecidas.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30k BRL

Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.

Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.

Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  • Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  • Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  • System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <1% downtime, <2 major incidents per quarter).
  • Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  • Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese; able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

title: Webflow Developer
description:
About you

You are someone who thrives in building scalable, high-impact solutions and who seeks to influence not just technology but also the direction of the product. You’re looking for a company where innovation and ownership go hand in hand, and where your contributions directly shape outcomes.

You bring to the team the following competencies:

  • 3+ years of experience in Webflow design and development.
  • Advanced JavaScript skills focused on accessibility and DOM manipulation.
  • Deep understanding of HTML / CSS
  • Experience with zapier is a plus but not 100% required.
  • Skilled in building reusable, accessible components and integrating CMS in Webflow.

description:
A Inetum é uma empresa global de serviços de TI, reconhecida por sua agilidade, inovação e compromisso com a transformação digital. Presente em mais de 29 países e com uma equipe de cerca de 28.000 colaboradores apaixonados e altamente qualificados, a Inetum alcançou uma receita de 2,3 bilhões de euros em 2023, consolidando sua posição como parceira confiável na entrega de soluções tecnológicas de alto impacto.

Com um portfólio diversificado e alinhado às necessidades do futuro, a empresa busca profissionais talentosos para integrar sua equipe de vendas no Brasil, com foco em soluções de TI nas seguintes áreas:

  • SAP: Implementação, upgrades, migrações, suporte contínuo, Business Intelligence (BI), análise de dados, auditoria e compliance.
  • Segurança Cibernética: Avaliação de riscos, proteção de dados, gestão de identidade e acessos, testes de penetração e simulação de ataques, além de soluções de privacidade e conformidade regulatória.
  • Digital: Análise de dados avançada (Data Science), Business Intelligence (BI), desenvolvimento de software customizado (web e mobile), automação de processos e integração de sistemas.
  • Infraestrutura de TI: Planejamento e implementação de soluções de infraestrutura, gerenciamento de redes e servidores, e monitoramento de ambientes de TI críticos.

Estamos em busca de profissionais com um perfil dinâmico, que compartilhem nossa paixão por tecnologia e inovação. Se você possui excelentes habilidades de comunicação, empatia para entender as necessidades dos clientes, foco em resultados e uma visão estratégica para oferecer soluções disruptivas e de longo prazo, você será um grande diferencial para a nossa equipe.

A Inetum oferece um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com oportunidades contínuas de crescimento profissional e aprendizado.

Se você está pronto para desafiar os limites e fazer a diferença em um cenário digital em constante evolução, essa é a oportunidade ideal.

Junte-se à Inetum e seja parte de um time que está sempre à frente do seu tempo, transformando o futuro com soluções tecnológicas de ponta!

title: Data Scientist
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que aderir à TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado e cheia de oportunidades de melhoria e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Cientista de Dados Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento de modelos analíticos e preditivos, transformando dados em insights acionáveis que suportem decisões estratégicas. O(a) profissional será responsável por explorar, analisar e modelar grandes volumes de dados, aplicando técnicas estatísticas e de machine learning.

O Cientista de Dados é responsável por todo o ciclo de vida dos dados, desde a coleta e limpeza até a análise e interpretação dos resultados, com o objetivo de impulsionar a inovação, otimizar processos e agregar valor ao negócio.

Responsabilidade:

  • Coletar, limpar, preparar e analisar dados de diferentes fontes.
  • Desenvolver, treinar e validar modelos de machine learning e estatística avançada. Implementar pipelines de dados e de modelagem para produção.
  • Realizar análises exploratórias para identificar padrões, tendências e oportunidades.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e analistas de negócio na definição de soluções. Documentar metodologias, resultados e processos de modelagem.
  • Experiência de 2 anos em ciência de dados.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, Seaborn.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e manipulação de dados.
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento e validação de modelos de machine learning.
  • Manipulação de grandes volumes.
  • Conhecimento básico em computação em nuvem.
  • Experiência com Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch).

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity
